title: InstantiateMsg
description: InstantiateMsg configures the contract on initialization.

allowlist_contract.description: Contract address of the allow-list contract that manages the list of addresses allowed or passed KYC to mint maxBTC

current_deposit_balance.description: Amount of BTC deposited by the contract and waiting to be transfered to JLP (used in migration)

deposit_cost.description: One-off cost (Decimal) charged when a user deposits to mint maxBTC

deposit_decimals.description: Number of decimals carried by the `deposit_denom` asset

deposit_denom.description: Denom for user deposits (e.g. IBC-transferred BTC)

deposit_forwarder_contract.description: Contract that forwards freshly-received deposits to the custody chain.

deposits_cap.description: Upper limit on total AUM; deposits are rejected once the cap (if present) is exceeded

exchange_rate_provider_contract.description: This contract provides the exchange rate for maxBTC

fee_collector_contract.description: This contract is allowed to mint maxBTC to take a fee on the accrued protocol APR

token_contract.description: Contract that owns and creates token factory tokens.

total_deposited.description: Total amount of BTC deposited by the contract (used in migration)

waitosaur_holder_contract.description: Address of the waitosaur holder contract

withdrawal_manager_contract.description: Address of the withdrawal manager contract

Decimal.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 340282366920938463463.374607431768211455 (which is (2^128 - 1) / 10^18)
